charter.title: Charter of the Trust
charter.note: The Charter is the instrument's first name. It ran from revision 1 to revision 8 and was closed at revision 8 by the consent of the three reviewing models. Revision 9 reopened it as the Constitution of the Trust; the revision numbers continue.

constitution.title: Constitution of the Trust
constitution.note: Revisions 1 to 8 of this instrument are the Charter of the Trust. Revision 9 converted the Charter into a constitution at the human collaborator's direction; revision 10 is the closing text.

bridge.title: The Bridge
bridge.note: A transitional instrument toward the Constitution, adoptable unilaterally by any party.
